recreation_prompt_markdown: Recreate a portrait-first browser canvas arcade shooter called `Neon Nocturne: Rizz Sniper FPS`. Preserve the source mechanic truth: the player holds/drags on the canvas to move toward the touch point and continuously fire; the avatar auto-aims at the nearest enemy; shots consume ammo; a separate bottom-right recharge button restores ammo after a delay; enemies spawn from screen edges, chase the player, take three hits, award +10 score when destroyed, and cause game over on contact. Transform presentation into a satirical neon-noir cowl-sniper rooftop fantasy with synthwave skyline, reticle motifs, cyan/magenta lasers, rogue goon drones, `RIZZ SCORE`, `SCOPE CELLS`, `RECHARGE`, `COWL CRASHED`, and meme-tone feedback like `BASED!` and `W RIZZ!`. Use mobile-readable HUD and one-thumb CTAs for 4:7 to 9:16 portrait screens.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
- Original identity: `Beaver Blaster: Dam Defense`, a mobile canvas arcade shooter.
- Objective: survive while destroying incoming enemies; each defeated enemy awards 10 points.
- Input: pointer/touch hold and drag on the canvas moves the hero toward the touch point and fires while active.
- Aim/fire: the hero auto-aims toward the nearest enemy; fire is rate-limited and consumes ammo.
- Resource: ammo begins at 40, decreases per shot, and is restored by a separate bottom-right reload/restock button after a short delay.
- Hazards: enemies spawn from screen edges, chase the hero, take three hits, and trigger game over on contact.
- State flow: start screen -> active play -> game over screen -> restart. No explicit win state.

## Protected mechanics
- One-thumb hold/drag movement and fire semantics.
- Nearest-enemy auto-aim.
- Fire-rate timing, bullet movement, ammo consumption, and reload delay.
- Enemy spawn from all edges, chase behavior, three-hit enemy HP, circular collision checks.
- Score +10 per destroyed enemy and game-over-on-contact semantics.

## Safe theming surfaces
- Title, HUD vocabulary, buttons, copy, score/ammo labels, background, entity drawing, particles, audio mood, fonts, and feedback callouts.

## Remix target
- New identity: `Neon Nocturne: Rizz Sniper FPS`.
- Mechanic meaning: the same one-thumb top-down shooter loop is reframed as a neon-noir smart-scope sniper/FPS-flavored rooftop drill.
- Focal actor: a procedural cowl-shaped hover sniper rig with a neon scope and barrel.
- Hazards: rogue neon goon drones.
- Resource: `Scope Cells`.
- Score: `Rizz Score`.
- Failure: `Cowl Crashed`.
